title: 7.9. Dassanahetuttika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… nanevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā ekatiṁsa, ārammaṇe aṭṭhavīsa, adhipatiyā ekūnatiṁsa …pe… vipāke nava …pe… avigate ekatiṁsa.
